name: Seven fixed monthly allocation rules; zero cash yield
pbo_score: mean monthly return in each of eight chronological test windows
multiple_testing: Holm over 14 hypotheses: seven profitability and seven static-benchmark comparisons; each uses the largest monthly/3m/6m p-value across full and chronological samples
pass_rule: Original fixed-rule profitability checks at every cost level, Holm adjusted profitability p < 0.05 at every cost level, native PBO <= 0.50 at every cost level. Benchmark superiority is evaluated separately.
selection_rule: Choose maximum mean monthly return in 2006-2015; assess this frozen choice in 2016-2025. Previously viewed historical data, not an untouched holdout.
limitations: Long-only unlevered ETF adaptations, not exact replications of futures research or proprietary models.
Reversal and inverse-volatility are exploratory controls, not claimed replications of cited momentum research.
Known surviving ETF universe and previously inspected history; unknown earlier searches/publication bias remain uncorrected.
ETF costs are assumptions; no CFD funding, taxes or broker-specific execution model. Cash earns exactly zero.
